name: medgraph_insight_pipeline
author: Li Jiabin; Li Jiahe; Yao Shuwen
description: DataMate-compatible custom operator for medical data cleaning, entity extraction, relation extraction, triple validation, and graph artifact export.

source.description: Path to JSONL, CSV, TXT, or directory input.

outputs.run: Pipeline run metadata and operator status.

outputs.sqlite: SQLite database used by NL2SQL and BI analysis.
outputs.quality: Graph quality audit with schema, evidence, alias, and false-triple checks.
